title: Compliance Analyst, Staff A-1

title: Product Counsel
description:
We are Progress (Nasdaq: PRGS) - the trusted provider of software that enables our customers to develop, deploy and manage responsible, AI-powered applications and experiences with agility and ease.  
We’re proud to have a diverse, global team where we value the individual and enrich our culture by considering varied perspectives because we believe people power progress. Join us as a **Product Counsel** and help us do what we do best: propelling business forward.

We are looking for a qualified and experienced Product Counsel to join our legal team and provide advice and support to our management and internal clients on various product related areas including product design, development and release, marketing, data protection, security and compliance. You will be working closely with our product management, engineering, design, product marketing, support, operations, compliance and business line executives. This role requires a business-minded in-house lawyer who will partner with multiple innovative product teams around the world to ensure that the company's products and services are structured to achieve the business strategy while complying with applicable regulations in multiple jurisdictions.

**In this role you will:**

* Partner closely with product management, engineering, design, product marketing, support, operations and compliance teams and provide counsel and advise on a wide variety of complex and developing legal, regulatory and compliance issues in connection with the delivery of cloud services.
* Advise on requirements affecting all stages of a product's life cycle, including design, development, marketing, public relations, product launch and distribution, and related product regulatory concerns.
* Support sales cycle, including developing and managing options for company agreements (including with customers, partners and vendors), answering questions, providing documentation, facilitating sales execution and negotiating agreements alongside commercial counsel.
* Serve as a liaison and issuer spotter for other legal team members in a matrixed organization with product teams, including in the areas of intellectual property, privacy, security and trade compliance.
* Ensure compliance with U.S. and international laws and regulations and company policy dealing with intellectual property, privacy, security, trade compliance and other applicable laws.
* Analyze, structure, draft, and negotiate technology development, licensing, and other commercial agreements and provide ongoing legal counseling in the areas of intellectual property, technology, and licensing.
* Review, draft and advise on advertising and marketing materials, including press releases, packaging, product launch collateral, sweepstakes, promotions, and other related items.
* Conduct training for the legal team as well as internal teams.

**Your background:**

* Law degree is required
* Minimum of 5 years of relevant in-house experience as a product counsel, preferably in the technology industry, with a focus on software, SaaS and cloud offerings.
* Significant experience with intellectual property, licensing, privacy and trade compliance in the technology sector.
* Ability to communicate effectively with product managers and engineers and apply legal principles based on understanding of technology architectures and principles.
* Able to multi-task, work independently in a fast-paced environment and to interface with internal departments and all levels of management.
* Maintain current understanding of best practices related to legal issues in product development and marketing for technology companies.
* Experience with HIPAA compliance is highly desired;
* Strong drafting and negotiation skills.

**Skills:**

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills.
* Strong business acumen and strategic thinking skills.
* Excellent drafting, negotiation, and communication Prior product counseling experience with a technology company;
* Startup mindset – highly passionate, team player, high sense of urgency, willingness to roll up sleeves and ability to deal with ambiguity in a fast-paced business;
* Excellent attention to detail, strong communication skills, well-honed analytical skills and strong project management skills;
* Strong technical skills with a continuous learning mindset to develop a deeper understanding of the business.

title: Senior Product Compliance & Risk Manager - India
description:
**Company Description**

Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money. Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.

Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.

As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money. For everyone, everywhere.

More about our mission and what we offer.

 **Job Description**

The Product Compliance & Risk (PC&R) team sits at the centre of Wise’s product development function, supporting our cross-functional teams to deliver exceptional compliant-by-design products for our customers.

We’re seeking a highly motivated, customer-centric individual to join our team to leverage their deep understanding of India regulatory requirements and expectations to launch new products, grow our presence and manage compliance risks in India.

This hands-on first line of defence (1LOD) role will involve working closely with product teams in APAC and globally to ensure our controls strike the right balance between meeting compliance requirements whilst maximising customer experience.

**This is a hands-on role, with high levels of ownership over:**

* Designing and continuously improving our products and controls: Leverage your deep understanding of the Wise product and regulatory requirements and risks to support new product launches. This includes communicating requirements in clear, practical terms, and taking a risk-based, scalable approach with the customer experience front-of-mind when designing, uplifting and implementing controls.
* Regulatory and financial crime risk management: Stay ahead of trends and the regulatory agenda in India, identify, assess and present risks quantitatively and qualitatively in clear and understandable terms, and work collaboratively to define and execute on risk mitigation plans.
* Regulatory change and remediation: Conduct regulatory gap analyses, define and scope actions to remediate gaps, and ensure implementation plans are executed in a timely manner. Collaborate with global teams to identify synergies with programs of work already completed or underway across the Wise Group, and ensure Wise Product teams are aware of the most recent regulations and guidance.
* External engagements: Represent Wise through external engagements such as audits and regulatory inspections, including explaining and defending our controls, and developing and executing remediation plans.

**This role will give you the opportunity to:**

* Grow your hands-on Fintech knowledge at full speed, with high levels of ownership and autonomy.
* Collaborate with our amazing teams both locally and globally to build state-of-the-art products for our customers that are compliant-by-design.
* Be empowered to identify problems and opportunities, and take a lead in the solution design and implementation.

**About you:**

* Expert in regulatory and financial crime compliance and risk management in India, with 10+ years experience in financial services (banking, fintech or consulting) and a deep understanding of the expectations of local regulators/policymakers.
* High levels of ownership and autonomy, with the ability to proactively identify improvement opportunities or areas of elevated risk, prioritise, and drive work from inception to completion at pace with limited oversight. This includes anticipating risks and roadblocks, and demonstrating resilience to work through them.
* Problem solving attitude, with the ability to not only analyse and interpret complex regulatory and risk management frameworks, but to exercise sound judgement in proposing and implementing customer-centric and scalable solutions, using data to drive decision-making and quantify risks.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to effectively interact with different audiences (from Product & Engineering teams to external auditors and regulators such as the RBI).
* Strong collaboration skills, to work effectively with different stakeholders globally (such as Product, Risk and Compliance), and to influence without authority.
* Challenge the status quo, thinking outside-the-box and questioning how we can achieve an optimal balance of achieving compliance whilst delivering the best outcomes for our customers.
* Previous experience working directly with product and engineering teams, including effectively translating regulations into actionable business requirements.
* Willingness to travel, as Wise offices are located across different countries.
* Legally authorised to work in India or Singapore.

**Nice to have but not essential:**

* Previous experience in working in a fintech or a similar fast-paced environment.
* Previous experience working with a PA-CB and/or ADII licensee.
* Experience working in cross-border teams.

 **Additional Information**

For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.

We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.  
Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.

If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs.

Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

title: Company Secretary
description:
**Job Title: Company Secretary**

**Job Overview**

We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated **Company Secretary** to join our organization. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in **corporate governance, statutory compliance, legal and regulatory requirements, cost management, and board administration**.

The Company Secretary will work closely with the **Board of Directors, senior management, shareholders, regulators, auditors, and external legal advisers** to ensure that the organization operates efficiently, transparently, and in compliance with all applicable laws and regulations.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Corporate Governance \& Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with all applicable statutory, regulatory, and corporate governance requirements.
* Maintain and update the company's statutory books, registers, records, and corporate documents.
* Monitor changes in legislation and regulatory requirements and ensure timely implementation of necessary actions.
* Ensure company policies and governance frameworks are current, compliant, and appropriately approved.
* Develop and implement processes and systems to strengthen compliance and organizational governance.

**Board \& Shareholder Management**

* Coordinate and manage Board of Directors, Board Committee, and Annual General Meeting (AGM) processes.
* Prepare meeting agendas, notices, board papers, presentations, and supporting documentation.
* Attend meetings and prepare accurate minutes, resolutions, and action points.
* Maintain proper records of Board and shareholder decisions and ensure timely follow\-up on agreed actions.
* Manage communications with shareholders and other key stakeholders.

**Legal \& Regulatory Liaison**

* Provide appropriate legal, governance, and regulatory guidance to the Board and senior management.
* Liaise with external legal counsel, auditors, regulators, government authorities, and other professional advisers.
* Ensure timely submission of statutory returns, filings, disclosures, and regulatory reports.
* Support the organization in managing corporate legal and regulatory matters.

**Cost Management \& Financial Oversight**

* Monitor and manage corporate governance, compliance, legal, secretarial, and administrative costs.
* Develop and monitor budgets related to the Company Secretarial and corporate governance functions.
* Identify opportunities to improve cost efficiency without compromising compliance or governance standards.
* Review professional fees, regulatory expenses, consultancy costs, and other related expenditures.
* Work with Finance and other departments to monitor expenses against approved budgets.
* Support management in implementing cost\-control measures and improving operational efficiency.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in law**, Business Administration, Commerce, Finance, or a related discipline**.
* Professional qualification as a **Chartered Secretary / Company Secretary** or equivalent.
* Minimum **8 years of relevant experience** in Company Secretarial, Corporate Governance, Legal Compliance, or a similar role.
* Strong knowledge of corporate governance principles, statutory requirements, and regulatory frameworks.
* Experience in cost management, budgeting, and expense monitoring will be an advantage.
* Strong understanding of Board and shareholder meeting procedures and corporate documentation.

**Key Skills \& Competencies**

* Strong corporate governance and compliance knowledge.
* Excellent organizational and time\-management skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Sound legal and commercial understanding.
* Strong stakeholder and relationship\-management abilities.
* Analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Budgeting, cost\-control, and financial management awareness.
* Ability to manage confidential and sensitive information with a high level of integrity.
* Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively with senior management and cross\-functional teams.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities.
* Proficiency in **Microsoft Office Suite, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint**.

Pay: ₹50,000\.00 \- ₹80,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Paid sick time
